name: Focus Timer
description: One clock, shared by everyone in the space. Turn the dial like a kitchen timer to set the length, press start, and the ring drains for everybody at once — a study room, a work sprint, a twenty-minute tidy that the whole house can see counting down. Whoever started it and what it is for are written under the dial. Editors drive the timer; viewers and anyone the timer is published to watch the same countdown live. There is no clock running anywhere: the session keeps only the moment the timer ends (its own state in the space, so two timers in one space run apart) and every device works out the rest for itself, so the numbers agree even if a device sleeps.
